$comment: Machine-readable companion to sync-policy.md. Read by scripts/check-sync-scope.js. Changing a transform changes what this fork is allowed to diverge on, so treat edits here as a governance change and explain them in the pull request.

sharedSurfaces.reason: Cross-plugin skill and library sources. Every adopting plugin carries a physical copy, so a change here is only half-applied until each per-plugin copy is refreshed.
Repository-wide validators and the installer. They run against every plugin regardless of adoption status.
CI. Runs on pull requests that touch plugins nobody has adopted.
Agent context loaded for all work in this repository, including work on plugins that are only mirrored.
Marketplace index. Determines which plugins the installer can resolve and which review record gates them.

equinorOwnedSurfaces.reason: Authored in this fork and absent upstream. Never overwritten by a sync.

transforms.summary: Upstream repository references replaced with the Equinor fork.
transforms.rationale: A plugin installed from this fork must send users, marketplace commands, and bug reports here, not to microsoft/power-platform-skills. Applies to every plugin regardless of adoption status because the install and issue paths are identical.

transforms.summary: The upstream 1DS telemetry stack is removed and its hook registrations, requires, and workflow markers are neutralised.
transforms.rationale: Telemetry is excluded pending a separate governance and privacy review. Upstream ships instrumentation keys enabled, so mirroring the stack verbatim would emit Equinor usage to a Microsoft collector.

transforms.summary: Upstream defects patched inside this fork. Closed to new entries.
transforms.rationale: These predate this policy and were added under review pressure on a sync pull request. Each one conflicts on every future sync and hides the defect from upstream, where all consumers need it fixed. Do not add entries; report the defect upstream and record it in the plugin's review record instead.
transforms.removal: Drop each entry once the fix lands upstream and a sync brings it back.
